title: sep47idx interface rule file
description: Describes the functions a SEP requires, by type. The matcher compares a contract's spec against it (CLAUDE.md §5.7). internal/match enforces the same constraints when loading.

sep.description: The SEP number this file describes.

ruleset_version.description: Changes whenever the rules change, so stored match results can be recomputed. Convention: sep<N>-v<SEP version>[-r<revision>].

source.description: Where the rules came from: SEP file, version, updated date, and the date it was diffed against the live text.

required.description: Functions every implementation must expose with these types.

optional.description: Functions an implementation may expose; if present they must have these types.

type.description: A canonical type name as rendered by sepmeta.TypeName, e.g. Address, i128, Option<u32>, udt:Name.

inputs.description: One element per parameter, in order. Each element lists the types accepted at that position.

output.description: Output types; empty for a function that returns nothing.
